description: This file manages application settings, theme, tab navigation, and data loading functions for the UI of the OpenClaw project. It includes functions for applying settings, handling URL parameters, theme synchronization, tab management, and loading various data modules.

classes.name: SettingsHost
classes.description: Represents the application settings state and related properties used for managing UI state, theme, session, and tab navigation.

methods.name: applySettings
methods.description: Applies new UI settings to the host, updates theme if changed, and saves settings.

methods.name: setLastActiveSessionKey
methods.description: Updates the last active session key in settings.

methods.name: applySettingsFromUrl
methods.description: Parses URL parameters to update session, token, gateway URL, and other settings accordingly.

methods.name: setTab
methods.description: Sets the current active tab and refreshes its content.

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Changes the application theme with transition effects.

methods.name: setThemeMode
methods.description: Changes the theme mode (light/dark/system) with transition effects.

methods.name: refreshActiveTab
methods.description: Loads data relevant to the current active tab.

methods.name: hasOperatorReadAccess
methods.description: Checks if the user has operator read access based on scopes.

methods.name: hasMissingSkillDependencies
methods.description: Determines if there are missing dependencies in skills.

methods.name: loadOverview
methods.description: Loads initial data for the overview dashboard.

methods.name: loadChannelsTab
methods.description: Loads data for the channels tab.

methods.name: loadCron
methods.description: Loads data related to cron jobs and status.

methods.name: inferBasePath
methods.description: Infers the base path for the application from URL or configuration.

methods.name: syncThemeWithSettings
methods.description: Synchronizes theme and theme mode with current settings.

methods.name: attachThemeListener
methods.description: Attaches system theme change listener.

methods.name: detachThemeListener
methods.description: Removes system theme change listener.

methods.name: applyBorderRadius
methods.description: Applies border radius settings to document root.

methods.name: applyResolvedTheme
methods.description: Applies a resolved theme to the document, updating data attributes and color scheme.

methods.name: syncSystemThemeListener
methods.description: Sets up or removes system theme change listener based on theme mode.

methods.name: syncTabWithLocation
methods.description: Synchronizes the current tab with URL location.

methods.name: onPopState
methods.description: Handles browser history popstate events to update tab and session.

methods.name: setTabFromRoute
methods.description: Sets the tab based on route information.

methods.name: syncUrlWithTab
methods.description: Updates URL to reflect current tab.

methods.name: syncUrlWithSessionKey
methods.description: Updates URL with current session key.

methods.name: loadOverviewLogs
methods.description: Fetches recent logs for the overview dashboard.

methods.name: buildAttentionItems
methods.description: Builds a list of attention items based on current app state.
